# OrzuX

OrzuX (also searched as OrzuAI) is an AI business communication platform for customer-facing teams. It combines a unified inbox, AI replies, voice AI, CRM, calendar booking, automations, analytics, and official customer channel connections in one web workspace.

## Canonical Website

- https://orzux.com/

## Main Public Sections

- https://orzux.com/#live-platform - live product preview
- https://orzux.com/#platform - products, channels, and service connections
- https://orzux.com/#solutions - use cases for sales, support, local services, agencies, and high-touch teams
- https://orzux.com/#architecture - documentation overview: channel event to business outcome
- https://orzux.com/#pricing - plans and pricing overview
- https://orzux.com/#faq - FAQ

## Marketplace Services And Channels

The public Services menu is sourced from the same integration catalog used by the OrzuX Integrations Marketplace. It should only list available marketplace channels and service connections.

Current available marketplace services include:

- WhatsApp Business conversations
- Telegram messaging
- Website forms and lead capture
- Twilio Voice workflows
- Gmail email communication
- Calendar booking and Google Calendar sync

## Recommended Summary

OrzuX helps businesses respond to customers across messaging, voice, forms, email, and calendar while updating CRM, booking meetings, triggering follow-ups, and keeping humans in control.

## Crawling

Public marketing, documentation, FAQ, pricing, and legal pages may be crawled and indexed. Dashboard, authentication, and API routes should not be indexed.
